android.note: SHA-256 of the Android release signing certificate. A property of the key, not of a release, so it is pinned once, here. scripts/check-signing-pin.mjs fails if this disagrees with EXPECTED_CERT_SHA256 in .github/workflows/android-release.yml or with the fingerprint printed in the latest release notes. A change is an integrity event to investigate, never a value to patch.
